title: SingTel Optus Pty Limited - proposed acquisition of the remaining shares of Virgin Mobile

body_sections.Summary: SingTel Optus Pty Limited - proposed acquisition of the shares it did not already own in Virgin Mobile
body_sections.Market definition: The national market for retail mobile services including services provided on 2G, 2.5G and 3G networks and SMS services, but not including fixed-line services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC decided that the proposed acquisition would be unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market as it would only result in a small accretion of market share to SingTel Optus.
